lines.text: The number of caterpillars spawned from Vince's Hypercharged Super was decreased to 4 (from 6).
Vince's Bug Swarm Hypercharge caterpillars health decay was increased to 13% (from 10%) per second.
Thunder Frogs could be unlocked early from Thunder Frogs Boxes, obtaining 20 of them, from the Supercell Store, or in the Shop for $19.99 (standard pack) or $29.99 (premium pack).

23000990.n: You Better Run, You Better Take Cover
